title: How MOSCATELLI records decisions
summary: Where a meaningful decision should be recorded, what context to preserve and how to leave a useful institutional trail.
contentNotice: Demonstration content for Atlas interface development; not final MOSCATELLI policy.

blocks.text: A useful decision record preserves the conclusion, owner, date and the material reasoning or constraint that explains why the decision was made.

blocks.label: The test
blocks.text: Someone who was not in the room should be able to understand what changed, who decided it and why the decision made sense at the time.

items: A change to an agreed product, supplier or launch direction
An exception to a published standard
A material financial or contractual commitment
A decision likely to be questioned or revisited later
A conclusion that changes another team member’s work

steps.title: State the decision
steps.text: Write the conclusion in one clear sentence.

steps.title: Preserve context
steps.text: Record the constraint, evidence or trade-off that materially shaped it.

steps.title: Name ownership
steps.text: Record the decision owner and any person responsible for the next action.

steps.title: Link the live work
steps.text: When relevant, connect the decision record to the MainHub item it affects.
